steps.label: Unlock
steps.text: When the wearer performs a basic attack, their Attack is permanently increased by 1%, stacking up to 15%.

guide.text: Allows The Flash to permanently stack bonus Attack with basic attacks, up to a limit. His Ultimate also increases the target's Ultimate damage for that cast. While he feeds allies Energy and Attack bonuses, he also builds up his own physical damage, adding real damage potential to his support kit.
